notes.title: New Pricing for Possession 1881
notes.notes:
Hello puzzle game fans!  After getting more and more feedback in the months following our release, we realized that the number of gameplay hours our original beta testers had reported were larger than what players were reporting.  Due to that discrepancy, we have adjusted our pricing permanently.  

We would like to offer heartfelt thanks to players who purchased the game in the first month of release at full price, without your support our little indie studio could not keep going!  

Thank you all again!
End of the Line Studios

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and thank you for your interest in Possession 1881!  We have fixed some bugs and modified some features in response to feedback from our great community.  The following is a list of changes:

[list]
[*] Added a launcher window for users with lower end graphics card.  If your video card has more than 1 GB of VRAM, feel free to leave the settings on Ultra.  If it's lower, you can adjust your settings to medium.
[*] Added mouse sensitivity settings.
[*] Fixed a save game bug that was preventing players from solving the Olmec cube
[*] Fixed some spelling and cosmetic errors.
[/list]

Thank you all and have fun gaming!
End of the Line Studios
